response.what_it_is: A portable gas cooker burner designed to mount directly onto a gas cylinder
hidden_risks: Valve leakage or faulty gas regulation
Incompatibility with standard Nigerian gas cylinder neck sizes
Thin gauge metal prone to warping under heavy pots
response.best_proof: Close-up shot of the gas valve and connection nozzle underneath
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the gas burner attachment for a full gas cylinder or an automotive engine cylinder component due to the title 'Cylinder Seater'.
